msg: Hello, we are 4 friends from Munich: two Advanced and two Open Water divers. We want two days of diving from Cartagena. What are the options and prices?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Rosario Islands are a fantastic place for a two-day dive trip! From Cartagena, you have two options for certified divers:

Both include the boat from Cartagena, dive equipment, insurance and lunch on day 1. You’ll need to stay *one night on the islands*; accommodation isn’t included and is booked directly with the hotel. The 5-dive option includes a night dive.

The 4-dive package has no online booking link, so a team advisor needs to help arrange it. The 5-dive package can be booked here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD

Would you like help connecting with an advisor about the 4-dive option?

msg: We'll take the 5-dive package, all 4 of us, next Friday and Saturday. We're German and we all dived within the last year.
reply:
Perfect! 🙌

🤿 *5 Dives - 2 days*
💰 *392 USD* per person (online rate) · 4 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 5 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch on day 1 and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/2-days-5-dives/9?language=en
